content: atp.recommendedPackage This tag provides a recommended package name for objects of the given meta class. Thereby it provides a value for {kind} . Usually it is the name of the meta class to which the tag is attached. Note that  this tag is propagated to subclasses  this tag only applies to subclasses of PackageableElement 27 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11
